abstract: OBJECTIVES: To report our experience in the management of patients with non-palpable lesions of the testis with a review of published studies. Even though radical orchiectomy remains the golden standard treatment for solid testicular masses there is an increasing role for testes-sparing surgery in a select group of patients with non-palpable tumors. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Between April 2000 and October 2004, a non-palpable testicular lesion was discovered on ultrasonography in six patients. Ultrasonography was performed for infertility in two patients, for testicular pain in three patients, and in one case for previous history of seminoma in the contra-lateral testis. RESULTS: Radical orchiectomy was performed in two patients, testis-sparing surgery with microsurgical excision and frozen-section examination (FSE) in two patients, and a conservative watchful waiting attitude was adopted in two patients. CONCLUSIONS: In a select group of patients, testis-sparing surgery with microsurgical dissection and FSE or a watchful waiting attitude can be safely adopted as an alternative to radical orchiectomy in the presence of incidentally discovered non-palpable testicular lesion.
abstract_ja: 目的：触知不能な精巣病変の治療経験を報告し、文献を概説する。根治的精巣摘除術は充実性精巣腫瘤の標準治療であるが、触知不能な腫瘍の選択された患者では精巣温存手術の役割が増している。患者と方法：2000年4月から2004年10月の間に、超音波検査で触知不能な精巣病変が6例で発見された。超音波検査は不妊症の2例、精巣痛の3例、対側精巣のセミノーマの既往の1例に対して実施された。結果：根治的精巣摘除術を2例に、顕微鏡下切除と凍結切片検査(FSE)による精巣温存手術を2例に、待機的経過観察を2例に実施した。結論：選択された患者では、顕微鏡下剥離とFSEを伴う精巣温存手術、または待機的経過観察が、偶然発見された触知不能な精巣病変に対する根治的精巣摘除術の安全な代替として採用できる。
